title: Neural Network Methods in the 2BSDE Formalism for Solving the High-Dimensional Black--Scholes Equation with Transaction Costs
abstract: arXiv:2610.41019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A 2BSDE system is written down for a $(D+1)$-dimensional Black--Scholes partial differential equation (PDE) with the Leland transaction cost model which incorporates the sign of the curvature. The 2BSDE system takes input from the ``speed'' (derivative of the curvature). This system is solved using a single ResNet neural network which learns both the solution to the PDE as well as the degrees of freedom in the curvature matrix. The network is used to learn the price of derivatives such as call options and butterfly spreads on geometric baskets for $D=10,100$ achieving a time-averaged RMSE of less than $0.1$ in each case.

translated_title: 2BSDE框架下的神经网络方法：求解带交易成本的高维Black-Scholes方程
translated_abstract: 针对采用Leland交易成本模型（该模型纳入了曲率符号）的$(D+1)$维Black-Scholes偏微分方程（PDE），本文建立了一个二阶倒向随机微分方程（2BSDE）系统。该2BSDE系统以“速度”（曲率的导数）作为输入。该系统通过单个ResNet神经网络求解，该网络同时学习PDE的解以及曲率矩阵中的自由度。该网络用于学习$D=10,100$情形下几何篮子上的看涨期权和蝶式价差等衍生品的价格，在两种情形下均实现了小于0.1的时间平均RMSE。
tldr: 本文提出用单个ResNet神经网络求解带Leland交易成本的高维Black-Scholes方程对应的2BSDE系统，同时学习PDE的解和曲率矩阵的自由度，在D=10和100维下对几何篮子上的衍生品定价均实现了小于0.1的时间平均RMSE。
en_tdlr: A single ResNet neural network solves the 2BSDE system for the high-dimensional Black-Scholes equation with Leland transaction costs, learning both the PDE solution and the curvature matrix degrees of freedom, achieving a time-averaged RMSE below 0.1 when pricing derivatives on geometric baskets for D=10 and 100.
